description: Dialog for inserting or editing a structured hyperlink on a cell. Supports four link kinds: Web, Email, InternalRef, NamedRange.

parameters.name: Workbook
parameters.description: The workbook (used for named range choices).

parameters.name: Hyperlink
parameters.description: The existing hyperlink to edit, or null for a new one.

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog is dismissed.

parameters.name: OnSave
parameters.description: Raised when the user saves the dialog.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the element focus returns to on close — the host spreadsheet passes its grid root so focus lands on the grid. Null falls back to the element focused before the dialog opened.
